chain_words.nuance: wide in extent, but not necessarily very large
covering a large area or range of things
very large in size, area, or amount
so large that it seems almost beyond measure
having no limits or edges at all

explanation: These words all describe great extent, from a wide space to something that seems to have no edge at all.

usage_notes.difference: 'Vast' describes something very large in size or area; 'boundless' suggests a limitless quality with no end or edge.
